item.title: Renting a Bicycle
item.description: Learn words for collecting a hired bicycle, checking its parts, and using a cycle lane.

children.definition: A hard cover you wear on your head to keep it safe if you fall.
children.example: At the hire point, I asked for a helmet that fit me.

children.definition: One of the two parts you push with your feet to make a bicycle move.
children.example: The left pedal felt loose, so I asked for another bike.

children.definition: A loop of small metal pieces that carries movement from the pedals to the back wheel.
children.example: The chain came off during the check, so the assistant gave me a different bike.

children.definition: A small part on a bicycle that makes a ringing sound to let people know you are coming.
children.example: Before I left, I rang the bell once to make sure it worked.

children.definition: The part of a bicycle that you sit on.
children.example: Could you lower the saddle a little before I take the bike?

children.definition: One of the two round parts that turn to let a bicycle move along the ground.
children.example: The front wheel did not turn freely, so I asked the assistant to look at it.

children.definition: A part of a bicycle that slows it down or stops it.
children.example: I tested the back brake while walking the hire bike across the yard.

children.definition: A tool that puts air into a bicycle tyre.
children.example: The assistant used a pump to put more air in the back tyre before I left.

children.definition: A fixed metal structure where you can leave a bicycle and secure it.
children.example: When I brought the bicycle back, I secured it to the bike stand by the door.
children.translation_uz: velosipedni qulflab qoʻyish uchun mahkam oʻrnatilgan tirgak
collocations: lock a bike to a bike stand
leave a bike at a bike stand

children.definition: The rubber part around a bicycle wheel that touches the ground.
children.example: The back tyre looked flat, so I asked the assistant to check it before I left.

children.definition: A small lamp on the front of a bicycle that helps you see ahead and helps others see you.
children.example: Before I left, I asked how to turn on the front light.

children.definition: A marked part of a road for people riding bicycles.
children.example: The assistant pointed out the cycle lane just outside the hire point.

children.definition: A cover over a bicycle wheel that stops water and dirt from getting on you.
children.example: It had just rained, so I asked for a bike with a mudguard over the back wheel.
children.translation_uz: velosiped gʻildiragi ustidagi loy sachrashidan saqlovchi qopqoq

children.definition: A place where you can get a bicycle to use for a short time and pay for using it.
children.example: We went to the hire point by the river to get our bicycles.
collocations: collect a bike from a hire point
return a bike to a hire point
